channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: Sunil Thapa dies of cardiac arrest; Priyanka Chopra pens heartfelt note, writes, 'You kept me together when I lost my dad'
item.description: According to several media reports, Sunil Thapa returned from a shoot and went to sleep. He was found unconscious the next morning. On arrival at the hospital, he was declared dead. The cause of death is reported to be cardiac arrest.

item.title: NC misleading people as there is no provision for 'special status' for J&K in Indian Constitution: BJP
item.description: Leader of Opposition and senior BJP leader Sunil Sharma on Saturday asserted in the Jammu and Kashmir Legislative Assembly that there is no provision for any "special status" for the Union Territory in the Constitution of India.

item.title: Home Minister Amit Shah assures J&K tourism continues to attract visitors post-Pahalgam attack
item.description: Union Home Minister Amit Shah stated that tourist interest in Jammu and Kashmir remains strong despite last year's Pahalgam attack that killed 26 people. He emphasised the need for aggressive promotion of J&K's destinations and assured that the BJP-led Centre will support new tourism initiatives.

item.title: CM Siddaramaiah targets Rs 10,000 crore chit fund transactions via MSIL, ensures secure investments
item.description: In Kerala, transactions in this sector amount to Rs 47,000 crore. In Karnataka, only Rs 500 crore of business is happening, and the institution has a goal to increase this amount to Rs 10,000 crore in the coming days, CM Siddaramaiah stated.

item.title: Nelson Dilipkumar's Rajinikanth-Kamal Haasan film promo shoot starts Saturday; expect a humorous teaser
item.description: One of the most-anticipated collaborations between Kamal Haasan and Rajinikanth is once again making headlines, with fresh buzz suggesting that the announcement promo shoot for their upcoming film is set to begin on February 7. The project has already generated immense excitement.

item.title: PM Modi introduces IMPACT – India-Malaysia partnership, announces first Indian consulate in Malaysia
item.description: India will soon open its first consulate in Malaysia, Prime Minister Modi announced. The Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) stated that the consulate will strengthen India-Malaysia cooperation and enhance engagement with the Indian community in Malaysia.

item.title: Delhi's air quality improves slightly to 'moderate' category, smog persists in several areas
item.description: Saturday's 'poor' AQI levels, though smog continued to persist across several areas. Pollution hotspots such as Mundka, Pusa, Narela and Rohini remained in the 'poor' category, while locations like Sri Aurobindo Marg, IGI Airport and Lodhi Road recorded comparatively cleaner air. The IMD has forecast misty conditions along with temperatures ranging between 10°C and 23°C, which may continue to impact visibility and air quality.

item.title: Dalai Lama's office rejects reports linking Tibetan spiritual leader to Jeffrey Epstein
item.description: The office of the Dalai Lama has firmly denied reports linking the Tibetan spiritual leader to convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein. The clarification came after media reports claimed the Dalai Lama's name appeared multiple times in documents released by the US Department of Justice as part of the Epstein case. The Dalai Lama's office stated that he never met Epstein nor authorised any interaction with him

item.title: Centre seeks inputs on proposed income-tax rules and forms
item.description: Before the final notification of the Income Tax Rules and Forms, to encourage wider stakeholder participation, the proposed Income Tax Rules and Forms have been uploaded on the official website, according to Finance Ministry on Sunday.

item.title: US trade deal boosts India's target of $250 billion engineering exports by 2030
item.description: The interim US-India trade deal framework has strengthened India's push to achieve $120 billion in engineering exports in FY2025-26 and its longer-term goal of $250 billion by 2030, according to the Engineering Export Promotion Council of India (EEPC). The deal includes reduced US tariffs on Indian goods to 18 per cent and preferential tariff rate quotas for automotive parts, improving market access and competitiveness for Indian exporters, particularly MSMEs.
